Causal trailing only; fail-closed to NaN/no-signal if RTE/DIAG_LINE_DENSITY_VARIANCE/ratio undefined/non-finite/degenerate or insufficient qualifying lines/gaps.

params.diag_line_density_variance_definition: DIAG_LINE_DENSITY_VARIANCE = sample variance ddof=1 of rho_k over off-diagonal diagonals k!=0 with >=1 qualifying diagonal run of consecutive 1s (length >= l_min=2); rho_k = (sum of qualifying run lengths l>=l_min on diagonal k) / (number of cells on diagonal k in embedded RP = M_pts-|k|). params.gap_definition: gap length w = number of consecutive 0-cells between successive recurrent points in a column (excluding trivial self at i==j)
